newsitem.title: USA: Burlington says would look at Amoco assets.
newsitem.headline: Burlington says would look at Amoco assets.

text.p: Burlington Resources Inc said it would look at the New Mexico assets which are part of Amoco Corp's planned sale of 15 percent of its U.S. reserves, but with no published price and few details, it is too early to make any decision.
"We are a 25 percent owner of San Juan basin, so we are a logical buyer, but it is far too early yet," said a spokesman for the company.

As well as reserves in New Mexico, Amoco is auctioning assets in Colorado, Wyoming, Oklahoma and the Gulf Coast and Burlington, which is one of the largest independent oil and gas producers in the U.S., and Union Pacific Resources Group Inc had been touted as potential buyers.
No one from Union Pacific was available for comment.
